topic.title: Brain: notes the agents share
topic.shortdesc: Long-term Markdown notes about customers, products, decisions and playbooks, read and written by the agents and by you. Every save is kept.

image.alt: The Brain page: a search box, the folder tree and an open note.

body.p: Notes are in a folder per area: dms/, 3dpandme/, personal/ and so on, with customers, products, decisions and playbooks inside, plus journal/ for the daily log and people/. Open a folder to see its notes; the + beside a folder starts a note in it.
What you write here is what the agents know. Correcting a note, such as a customer's preferred courier or a pricing rule, is the way to change how they act.
Type in Search notes and choose Search. Results show a snippet and the path. An empty search, or Show all folders, brings back the folders.

ol.li: Choose New note, or Edit on a note.
For a new note, set the Path, such as personal/ideas.md. It must end in .md and can't be changed later.
Write the Note in Markdown. The block between --- lines at the top is its frontmatter (type, vertical, entities).
Choose Save. It is live straight away.

body.p: If you see Someone (or an agent) saved this note after you opened it, choose Load the latest and make your change again.
History lists every version with who saved it, you or an agent. View shows an old version and Restore makes it current again. Delete keeps the history, so a deleted note can be restored.
